$comment: Production advisories accepted on purpose. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry; an expired entry fails CI again, so the decision is revisited. Checked by scripts/audit-gate.mjs.

accepted.reason: OAuth state used as magic link: a server feature. better-auth runs as Neon's hosted auth service; Osirus only imports @neondatabase/auth/next (session cookies and proxy). The fix (>=1.7.7) is not in any @neondatabase/auth release yet (0.7.0-beta pins 1.7.6).
OAuth Proxy plugin, server side; not used by Osirus. Same upstream pin as above.
Device authorization plugin, server side; not used by Osirus.
Test runner pulled into the production tree only because better-auth declares vitest as a dependency; never imported by the app or bundled.
As above (vitest via better-auth), never imported at runtime.
Dev server (launch-editor, Windows) pulled in by vitest via better-auth; no dev server runs in production.
Build-time source map parsing (postcss under Next); no untrusted source maps are parsed at runtime.
